Tool or resource page named by the toolkit

description: Coastal Inundation Dashboard is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS). Check real-time water levels, 48-hour forecasts of water levels, and historic flooding information at coastal monitoring stations. Boaters and fishermen can access information on their latest local tides. The site shows a map-based view of stations along the U.S. coast where flooding may be occurring. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Critical Facilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
